name: London School of Geometry and Number Theory
header:
London School of Geometry and Number
Theory
United Kingdom · Four-year funded PhD CDT jointly at UCL, Imperial and King’s College London
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Arithmetic geometry applicants must choose Number Theory rather than the Both checkbox.
• Reference requests go out only on submission, just before a holiday-period deadline.
• Separate project summary/course descriptions mandatory; unsolicited thesis explicitly excluded.
• International award does not pay visa/NHS surcharge.
• Faculty directory contains older ranks/affiliations, so institution dossiers provide current verification.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Explicitly welcomes outstanding US bachelor applicants: complete a very good four-year mathematics/closely
related degree by September 2027. A separate master is not universally required. International students
eligible; admissions and institutional English conditions apply. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare central application, required EDI form and additional research-study-area form ranking two topics.
Choose two institutions without ranking. Select Geometry or Number Theory, ignore Both; arithmetic geometry
belongs in Number Theory. Consult referees before submission. [s1]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior advisor selection required; contact a particular desired person to explore capacity if you have a clear
preference. Final supervisor selected at end of first year. See Imperial/UCL dossiers for recent-paper-verified
relevant researchers; King’s directory expands choices. [s1] [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Saved application URL emailed at start; edits permitted until submission only. First year physically at UCL,
formally registered at university in offer; years2-4 at research institution. Two unranked institution choices
required. [s1] [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit September 2027 deadlines and funding. Non-www application page and homepage say open; www
cached page still has closed footer. Current homepage corroborates open state. [s1]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
31 December 2026, 23:59 London time. Opens 1 November 2026; September 2027 intake. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Same central application deadline, 31 December 2026 23:59 London; no separate programme studentship
application specified. [s1]

Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
3 January 2027; public page does not specify a clock/timezone for references. Submit application early enough
for automatic invitations and holiday availability. [s1]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Institutional English evidence can follow selection/interview and must be supplied before September entry;
exact offer-condition date not published. [s1]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Required profile and official transcripts accompany application by 31 December 2026 23:59 London. No extra
theses/papers will be reviewed unless Centre Manager requests them. [s1]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Offers March-April 2027; no universal acceptance deadline stated. Follow offer letter. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Meet English rules of university on offer. Page refers to UCL Standard and also links Imperial/King’s. It explicitly
says programme does not offer English waivers; proof is not needed at initial application. [s1]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Host institution degree-based satisfaction may differ from discretionary waiver. Imperial exempts completed
US degree holders, while LSGNT says no waivers. Obtain written clarification that a completed UChicago
degree satisfies host rules; do not assume programme waiver automatically applies. [s1] [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No GRE requested in exhaustive listed document set; extra documents not reviewed. Explicit GRE-specific
policy not stated. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
No mathematics GRE requested; unsolicited extra documents excluded. No stated GRE-specific
required/recommended policy. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two academic references. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Same two references support central funded competition; no third scholarship reference specified. [s1]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Automatic email request immediately after application submission; verify addresses beforehand. [s1]

Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes; submitting triggers invitations. Entering names alone is not described as sending requests. [s1]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Programme does not individually confirm receipt; ask referees. It chases missing letters after 3 January and
notifies applicant if outstanding. No portal receipt indicator promised. [s1]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Cannot return to application after submitting. Letter replacement/reuse not publicly documented; contact
Centre Manager if needed. [s1]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required within single profile PDF, maximum two A4 pages. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required personal statement, maximum one A4 page, within profile. Faithful paraphrase: explain mathematical
development/interests and an appealing topic/theorem, why it interests you, and relevant area; optional
preferred academics/institutions. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Same one-page personal statement; no additional general background essay listed. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Part of personal statement plus topic-selection form; research choices do not commit you permanently. Rank
two topics in additional form; programme area checkbox uses Geometry or Number Theory. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No full research proposal requested; supervisor/topic chosen after first year. Do not add unsolicited proposal.
[s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Required project descriptions: approximately a paragraph per project, maximum one A4 page total, within
profile. Do not upload thesis or extra papers. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate publications document requested; mandatory CV may list outputs, but no full-paper upload
invited. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
One A4 page maximum for last-two-years topics and relevant course descriptions, inside profile. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No separate scholarship essay specified beyond central applicant profile. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
One combined profile PDF named surname then firstname (for John: FeffermanJohn.pdf). Put applicant name at
top, next both referees’ names; overseas applicants resident in UK state settled/pre-settled/neither status.
Required EDI form and additional topic form. No font/file-size limit published. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Explicit 2027 intake: full fees; tax-free annual stipend including London weighting £24,522 year1, £25,260
year2, £26,021 year3, £26,800 year4. Years2-4 are estimates, reconfirmed annually. Paid in 12 monthly
instalments; £4,800 research-training support grant plus possible additional fund and laptop. Visa/NHS
surcharge excluded. [s1]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Four years: initial training year followed by three research years. [s1] [s2]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
Fully funded Home and Overseas studentships offered; international award numbers not specified. Visa and
NHS surcharge costs are not funded. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Selection competitive; first-year progress assessed through attendance, courses, presentations and two
mini-projects. No formal teaching requirement; optional opportunities exist. No first-year exams according to
FAQ. [s1] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Central application and compulsory EDI/research-topic forms; no separate ordinary studentship form listed. [s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Additional research-expense fund can be applied for; external sponsorship and alternate host awards require
separate checking. No extra annual maintenance guarantee beyond programme package. [s1]
Application fee [Standing rule]
No application fee. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Not needed: central LSGNT application free. [s1]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Explicitly welcomes outstanding US bachelor applicants: complete a very good four-year mathematics/closely
related degree by September 2027. A separate master is not universally required. International students
eligible; admissions and institutional English conditions apply. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare central application, required EDI form and additional research-study-area form ranking two topics.
Choose two institutions without ranking. Select Geometry or Number Theory, ignore Both; arithmetic geometry
belongs in Number Theory. Consult referees before submission. [s1]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior advisor selection required; contact a particular desired person to explore capacity if you have a clear
preference. Final supervisor selected at end of first year. See Imperial/UCL dossiers for recent-paper-verified
relevant researchers; King’s directory expands choices. [s1] [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Saved application URL emailed at start; edits permitted until submission only. First year physically at UCL,
formally registered at university in offer; years2-4 at research institution. Two unranked institution choices
required. [s1] [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit September 2027 deadlines and funding. Non-www application page and homepage say open; www
cached page still has closed footer. Current homepage corroborates open state. [s1]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Meet English rules of university on offer. Page refers to UCL Standard and also links Imperial/King’s. It explicitly
says programme does not offer English waivers; proof is not needed at initial application. [s1]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Host institution degree-based satisfaction may differ from discretionary waiver. Imperial exempts completed
US degree holders, while LSGNT says no waivers. Obtain written clarification that a completed UChicago
degree satisfies host rules; do not assume programme waiver automatically applies. [s1] [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No GRE requested in exhaustive listed document set; extra documents not reviewed. Explicit GRE-specific
policy not stated. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
No mathematics GRE requested; unsolicited extra documents excluded. No stated GRE-specific
required/recommended policy. [s1]
Academic records

Upload official undergraduate and any postgraduate transcripts showing all grades obtained to date;
qualification need not yet be completed. Later final evidence follows offer. [s1]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required topic list covering last two years, maximum one A4 page, in applicant-profile PDF. [s1]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Include brief descriptions of most relevant courses inside that one-page topic list. [s1]

Two academic references. [s1]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required within single profile PDF, maximum two A4 pages. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required personal statement, maximum one A4 page, within profile. Faithful paraphrase: explain mathematical
development/interests and an appealing topic/theorem, why it interests you, and relevant area; optional
preferred academics/institutions. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Same one-page personal statement; no additional general background essay listed. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Part of personal statement plus topic-selection form; research choices do not commit you permanently. Rank
two topics in additional form; programme area checkbox uses Geometry or Number Theory. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No full research proposal requested; supervisor/topic chosen after first year. Do not add unsolicited proposal.
[s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Required project descriptions: approximately a paragraph per project, maximum one A4 page total, within
profile. Do not upload thesis or extra papers. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate publications document requested; mandatory CV may list outputs, but no full-paper upload
invited. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
One A4 page maximum for last-two-years topics and relevant course descriptions, inside profile. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No separate scholarship essay specified beyond central applicant profile. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
One combined profile PDF named surname then firstname (for John: FeffermanJohn.pdf). Put applicant name at
top, next both referees’ names; overseas applicants resident in UK state settled/pre-settled/neither status.
Required EDI form and additional topic form. No font/file-size limit published. [s1]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Explicit 2027 intake: full fees; tax-free annual stipend including London weighting £24,522 year1, £25,260
year2, £26,021 year3, £26,800 year4. Years2-4 are estimates, reconfirmed annually. Paid in 12 monthly
instalments; £4,800 research-training support grant plus possible additional fund and laptop. Visa/NHS
surcharge excluded. [s1]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Four years: initial training year followed by three research years. [s1] [s2]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
Fully funded Home and Overseas studentships offered; international award numbers not specified. Visa and
NHS surcharge costs are not funded. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Selection competitive; first-year progress assessed through attendance, courses, presentations and two
mini-projects. No formal teaching requirement; optional opportunities exist. No first-year exams according to
FAQ. [s1] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Central application and compulsory EDI/research-topic forms; no separate ordinary studentship form listed. [s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Additional research-expense fund can be applied for; external sponsorship and alternate host awards require
separate checking. No extra annual maintenance guarantee beyond programme package. [s1]
Application fee [Standing rule]
No application fee. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Not needed: central LSGNT application free. [s1]
